You are required to have access to a long code or a short code for receiving incoming messages from customers and sending responses to their messages. Please contact your Webex Connect account manager for number provisioning requests.

Once a number has been provisioned to your tenant, it is visible under 'Assets -> Numbers' screen.

Once a number has been provisioned to your Webex Connect tenant for supporting SMS as a channel for customer service, you would need to register it on Cisco Contact Center Enterprise (CCE) to complete the asset configuration process. 

## 

Registering your Webex Connect Phone Number with Webex Engage

- Go to Assets -> Numbers.

- Select Phone Number from the Number Type.

- Select the required Phone Number which you want to register with Webex Engage.

- Click Manage.

- The Manage Phone Number page displays.

 [Image: Screenshot of Manage Phone Number Page] 
Screenshot of Manage Phone Number Page

 [Image: Screenshot of Register to Webex Engage] 
Screenshot of Register to Webex Engage

- Click Register to Webex Engage.

- Select the required service (Note: This should be the Webex Connect service that would be used for configuring SMS flows for Cisco Contact Center Enterprise integration and click Register.)

 [Image: Screenshot of registering the asset successfully with Webex Engage] 
Screenshot of registering the asset successfully with Webex Engage

A message displays “Asset registered successfully”. This completes the asset registration for Cisco Contact Center Enterprise integration.

 [Image: Screenshot displaying the Webex Contact Center icon and PCI check enabled flag next to a mapped number.] 
Screenshot displaying the Webex Engage icon and PCI check enabled flag next to a mapped number.

As shown above, you will see a Webex Engage icon and a PCI check enabled flag next to the number once it's been successfully mapped with Contact Center Enterprise.

## ❗️

- 

Please note, the service mapping cannot be changed once done. Hence, the asset registration on Webex Engage should be done after the service to be used has been decided.

- 

Do not release a number that you are using for providing customer support over SMS as a channel as it will cause disruptions to live services. Released numbers are delinked from your Webex Connect and cannot be restored.
